readout_other: Movement-related cortical potential (MRCP) peak-to-peak amplitude; offline BCI classification accuracy of left vs right hand grasp (shrinkage LDA); FDS EMG
direction_notes: Left M1 tFUS amplified left-hemisphere MRCP amplitude and offline BCI classification accuracy relative to rPFC spatial sham and non-modulated conditions; no differences across PRF (30 vs 3000 Hz) or duty cycle (30 vs 60%), and no change in EMG or right-hemisphere signals.
safety_notes: Subject-specific transcranial dosing estimated with Sim4Life; values stated to be within ITRUSST (MItc < 1.9) and FDA diagnostic guidelines. No adverse event reporting.

exposures.label: Left primary motor cortex hand knob (LM1), 4 PRF x DC parameter sets

target.label: hand knob of the left primary motor cortex (LM1)

device.manufacturer: Blatek Industries Inc., Boalsburg, PA, USA
device.model: single-element focused transducer (1.5 inch focal length, 1 inch aperture diameter, 0.75 inch radius of curvature)

timing.protocol_description: A single 500 ms pulse train was delivered time-locked to the visual cue on every trial (70 trials per block, ~5 s fixation between). Cycles per pulse, PRF and pulse number varied to keep Isppa and sonication duration constant; PRF 30 or 3000 Hz crossed with DC 30% or 60%. Controls: non-modulated baseline (transducer off) and two rPFC shams at 30 Hz/30% and 3000 Hz/30%.
